summary: Verified against main @ 31d512f. Every cited file and range was opened; nothing in the repo was edited. Results: 21 findings checked, with 4 confirmed, 17 adjusted and 0 refuted. Of the 3 splits, 1 is confirmed and 2 are adjusted. The core diagnosis holds. client.rs is a 1395-line god file, and its production code sits in two impl blocks (62-315 and 517-1075). execute_control_with_identity_if is one 24-arm match (781-1074). obs/ imports controller::event::ConnectionInfo (client.rs:14, mapper.rs:12), and architecture_tests.rs has no rule against it. Every obws error becomes AppError::Request(String). Mapping code is duplicated across files. Recurring problem in the reviewer's output: line numbers for the small files are wrong, apparently offsets from a concatenated listing. The real lengths are audio_presets.rs 63 lines, operator_inputs.rs 104 and sources.rs 314, so citations such as operator_inputs.rs 297-372 or sources.rs 383/437 point past the end of the file. The corrected ranges are recorded below. Substantive corrections: (1) ControlSnapshot.scenes is used by the preflight review and editor (ui/preflight.rs:287-291, ui/preflight/editor.rs:37-42), so 'drop it' is not an option. Fill it from map_scenes instead, and note that this changes the order users see in preflight. (2) next_observation is called in refresh_controller.rs (196, 212, 268, 493-516), not in app_controller.rs:331. Moving it out of ObsClient means threading a per-connection handle into the refresh tasks. (3) The control snapshot does not hide timeouts: a deadline retires the gate (requests.rs:183-186). Only OBS rejections are swallowed. (4) A stale-ticket skip being reported as Disconnected is real (requests.rs:166, 181), but the controller drops superseded results by ticket (controller/workspace.rs:387-389), so the impact is smaller than claimed. (5) A Mutex poison in RequestGate is practically unreachable, because neither critical section can panic. (6) Moving mock_client also requires updating controller/workspace/audio_presets/tests.rs:2, which imports obs::client::control_tests::mock_client. (7) tokio start_paused combined with a real loopback socket may fire the 15 s connect timeout early through auto-advance. An injected timeout is the safer fix. None of the proposed obs-internal splits create a cycle: pub(super) items in obs::client stay visible to obs::control::* descendants. The splits do not break architecture_tests, which stay green as long as obws stays under src/obs/.

findings.title: client.rs is a god file: two interleaved impl blocks, ~800 lines of tests and one facade covering every OBS request category
findings.evidence: First `impl ObsClient` at 62-315, then `mod tests` at 317-515. The second `impl ObsClient` at 517-1075 holds get_control_snapshot, thumbnails, screenshots, get_source_detail and execute_control*. Free fns at 1077 and 1089, `pub(crate) mod control_tests` at 1099-1392, and `#[path = "regression_tests.rs"]` at 1393-1395. The sibling modules audio.rs, sources.rs, operator_inputs.rs, scene_activation.rs and audio_presets.rs already use the extension-impl pattern.
findings.recommendation: Split by OBS request category into `impl ObsClient` extension modules (see proposed_splits). client.rs keeps only the struct, connect, lifecycle, request/mutation, endpoint/with_connection_id and get_version. Move collect_bounded_ordered and MAX_CONCURRENT_OBS_REQUESTS (24-49) to src/obs/concurrency.rs.
findings.risk: Every new OBS capability lands in this file.
findings.verifier_note: Read client.rs 1-316, 517-1150 and the item index. The layout matches the reviewer's description: second impl at 517, control_tests at 1100, #[path] include at 1393-1395. Visibility check: `inner`, `request` and `mutation` are pub(super) (54, 154, 161), so they are visible to every descendant of crate::obs, including obs::control::*. The split needs no visibility widening.

findings.title: execute_control_with_identity_if is a ~290-line, 24-arm switch that mixes validation, identity resolution and wire translation
findings.evidence: One match over ControlAction (domain/control.rs 222-285, 24 variants confirmed). SeekMedia reads before it writes (918-942). SetText does two reads before its write (960-996). The uuid-or-name fallback appears 13 times: 11 as `uuid.map(InputId::Uuid).unwrap_or(InputId::Name(input))`, plus SceneId at 801 and SourceId at 953.
findings.recommendation: Create src/obs/control/mod.rs holding the dispatcher. It resolves identity once, then delegates by category to control/studio.rs, control/outputs.rs, control/media.rs, control/items.rs, control/text.rs and control/audio_controls.rs. Pick one name, audio_controls.rs, so it does not collide in readers' minds with src/obs/audio.rs. First add a non-breaking `ControlAction::category()` in domain/control.rs. Only later consider sub-enums (StudioAction, OutputAction, ...), because every UI constructor and label site changes with them: ui/workspace.rs 40-77, ui/widgets/studio_controls.rs:163, ui/widgets/operating_panel.rs 1395/1418. Move the obws enum translations to the mapper (obs-acl-07).
findings.smell: Switch Statements / Long Method / Duplicate Code
findings.risk: Every new operator control widens one function.
findings.verifier_note: The diagnosis is confirmed. Corrections: the fallback appears 13 times, not 12, and SeekMedia/SetText are at 918-942 and 960-996, not 939-949 and 963-990. Sub-enums are an L-sized change across ui/ and should come after the mechanical split, so this verdict stages category() first. Unify the target file name (control/audio_controls.rs in the finding versus control/audio.rs in the split).

findings.title: Domain rules (valid ranges) live in the OBS adapter, and ControlAction carries raw primitives
findings.evidence: Range checks in the adapter: transition duration `!(50..=20000).contains(ms)` at 846, volume `MIN_VOLUME_DB..=MAX_VOLUME_DB` plus is_finite at 1008, sync `-950..=20000` at 1037, balance finite 0..=1 at 1050. ControlAction fields: SetTransitionDuration(i64) at 237, SeekMedia position_ms i64 at 250, SetInputVolumeDb db f64 at 267, SetAudioSync offset_ms i64 at 275, SetAudioBalance balance f32 at 279. The UI repeats a bound: operating_panel.rs balance `SpinButton::with_range(0.0, 1.0, 0.01)` near 1404.
findings.recommendation: Add value objects in src/domain/control/values.rs, or domain/audio.rs for the audio ones: TransitionDuration, VolumeDb, AudioSyncOffset and AudioBalance, each with TryFrom. Change the ControlAction fields to these types. ControlAction derives only Debug, Clone and PartialEq (domain/control.rs:221), not serde, so there is no storage migration. The UI constructors (studio_controls.rs:163, operating_panel.rs 1395, 1418) must handle a TryFrom failure explicitly, either by clamping to the spin range or by showing a toast. Do not panic. Move the range tests to domain. Keep one wire test (regression_tests.rs 339-378) proving the canonical values are sent. The SeekMedia fresh-duration check (927-933) stays in the adapter.
findings.risk: Bounds duplicated in UI spin ranges can drift from the adapter.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed, with line numbers corrected (the reviewer cited 851-853, 939-948 and others). Added: the actual UI duplication evidence, the fact that ControlAction is not serialized, and the list of UI call sites that must handle TryFrom errors. The test at client.rs 1373 (invalid_audio_values_never_reach_obs) exists as cited.

findings.title: The OBS adapter imports a controller type (ConnectionInfo), and no architecture test catches it
findings.evidence: mapper.rs:12 and client.rs:14 both have `use crate::controller::event::ConnectionInfo;`. A grep confirms these are the only production references from obs/ to controller, ui, storage or services. ConnectionInfo (controller/event.rs 11-18) holds six String/Vec fields. architecture_tests.rs has rules for ui->obs (549), obws confinement (566), domain purity (589), services GTK (607), storage reach (625), navigation (647) and background GTK (669), but no rule on what obs/ may import.
findings.recommendation: Move ConnectionInfo to src/domain/obs.rs, next to ObsNamedList (line 5), and name it ObsSessionInfo. Re-export it from controller/event.rs during migration. 13 files reference the type. Add `obs_adapter_depends_only_on_domain_and_infra` to architecture_tests.rs using `violations("obs", &["crate::controller", "crate::ui", "crate::storage", "crate::services"], &[])`. The scanner exempts test-only code, but check that obs test code importing controller fixtures, if any appears later, is covered by #[cfg(test)].
findings.risk: The obs and controller cycle blocks extracting obs into its own crate.
findings.verifier_note: Imports, struct and missing rule all verified. violations(scope, forbidden, exempt) has the signature shown at architecture_tests.rs:351. The new rule passes once the type moves, because no other obs->controller import exists.

findings.title: obws errors are flattened to strings, so callers detect retirement through a side channel and tests match substrings
findings.evidence: AppError::request stringifies everything (infra/error.rs 36-38). retirement_reason() returns Option<String> (requests.rs 110-115; client.rs 144-146). Callers poll it: refresh_controller.rs 576 and 580-583, where the English reason string becomes tx.terminal_reason and therefore user-visible text, without fl!. Other callers: controller/workspace.rs:380 and controller/workspace/audio_presets.rs 42, 59, 206. Substring assertions in tests: regression_tests.rs 489 contains("timeout"), 154, 175, 195 and 617. audio.rs 18-21 is_non_audio matches the exact OBS message text.
findings.recommendation: Add src/obs/error.rs with `pub(crate) enum ObsError { Rejected { code, comment }, Retired(RetirementReason), Timeout, Superseded, Transport(String), InvalidIdentity(String), RejectedLocally(ControlRejection) }`. Implement From<obws::error::Error> for ObsError and From<ObsError> for AppError, so the existing AppError surface keeps compiling. Move RetirementReason to domain/obs.rs. Have retirement_reason() return Option<RetirementReason>, and localize it in the controller or UI with fl! (refresh_controller.rs:580-583 already uses fl! for the fallback). is_non_audio stays as an adapter-internal classifier, because matching the OBS message is a protocol quirk (status 604 alone is ambiguous), but it should yield a typed variant. Migrate one category at a time.
findings.risk: The rule 'failed command must not look like a disconnect' depends on every caller remembering the side-channel check.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. Corrections: the reviewer's enum contained a soft-hyphen typo ('Rejected­Locally'), now 'RejectedLocally'. Added `Superseded`, which obs-acl-13 needs. Added that the English retirement message is shown to users through terminal_reason (refresh_controller.rs 580-583). Removed the client.rs:1211 substring citation, which I did not find. is_non_audio must stay in the adapter.

findings.title: Identity handling: one UUID is reused for all target kinds, ignored by some actions, parsed in four places, and nil-checked inconsistently
findings.evidence: target_uuid is parsed as InputId::Uuid (789-792) and reused through as_uuid() for SceneId (801) and SourceId (953). SetItemEnabled uses SceneId::Name(owner) (817) and SetProgram uses SceneId::Name(name) (833), so a supplied uuid is ignored for both. SetTransition takes a name only in the obws API (842), so that one is not a defect. The parse-or-fallback is repeated at audio_presets.rs 38-45, operator_inputs.rs 94-113 and audio.rs 194-200. Nil handling: mapper.rs 44 and 207 and audio.rs 50 map nil to None. sources.rs:139 does `input.id.uuid.to_string()` unconditionally into a HashMap<String,String>, and SourceItem.input_uuid gets `.unwrap_or_default()` (216-219). The result is a nil string "00000000-..." or an empty string, never None. controller/workspace.rs 329-331 forwards request.target_uuid for every action. ui/workspace.rs:245 act_identified sets it.
findings.recommendation: Add an ObsUuid value object (src/domain/identity.rs, or extend operator_action::ActionTarget) that parses and rejects nil once. Add src/obs/identity.rs with input_ref, source_ref, scene_ref and optional_uuid. Replace the four parse sites and sources.rs:139. Make SourceItem.input_uuid an Option<String>; that is a domain change, so check its consumers. Reject a supplied uuid for actions that cannot use it, or carry the identity inside the ControlAction variant.
findings.risk: Wrong or blank identity after a rename.
findings.verifier_note: Substance confirmed. Line numbers for audio_presets.rs, operator_inputs.rs and sources.rs were wrong; those files are 63, 104 and 314 lines long. Corrected ranges above. SetTransition removed as a defect, since the API has no uuid there. Whether any UI path calls act_identified with SetItemEnabled or SetProgram is still unverified, so the silent drop is latent, not demonstrated.

findings.title: The mapper is incomplete: about 9 obws-to-domain conversions are inline, duplicated, or disagree with each other
findings.evidence: (1) get_control_snapshot builds Scene without .rev() (529-538), while map_scenes reverses (39-47). (2) ObsNamedList at 215-218 and 231-234. (3) SourceFilter at client.rs 684-691 and operator_inputs.rs 144-148. (4) MediaStatus at client.rs 700-705 and operator_inputs.rs 123-127. (5) MonitorType to AudioMonitor at 744-750, where `_ => Off`. (6) AudioMonitor to MonitorType at 1025-1031. (7) MediaAction at 906-913. (8) InputIdentity at audio.rs 46-55. (9) ConnectionInfo patched at 188-193. ControlSnapshot.scenes is read by ui/preflight.rs:287-291 (PreflightSnapshot.scenes) and ui/preflight/editor.rs:37-42 (editor scene list). ui/preflight/tests.rs:62 seeds it from scene_inventory.scenes, so the tests assume switcher order, which production does not provide.
findings.recommendation: Move these into mapper submodules (obs-acl-08). get_control_snapshot must call map_scenes so there is one canonical order. Do NOT drop ControlSnapshot.scenes. Map an unknown MonitorType to an explicit variant or log it. Add a wire-JSON round-trip test per mapping.
findings.risk: The scene order in the preflight editor is reversed compared with the OBS switcher and the rest of the app.
findings.verifier_note: The duplications are confirmed, with every line number corrected. The claim 'snapshot copy effectively unused' is REFUTED: preflight review and editor consume snapshot.scenes. The ordering mismatch is therefore user-visible (unverified in a running UI, but the editor clones the list as is), and the drop option is removed. Fixing the order is a behavior change: commit it separately with a test.

findings.title: mapper.rs mixes response mapping, event mapping and placeholder data; tests take half the file
findings.evidence: map_event is at 151-243. Tests are at 259-561, with `use super::*;` at 369 in the middle of the test module, after earlier tests. map_version writes the placeholders "default" and String::new() (22-24), which client.rs 189-191 overwrites. map_output_state has both `OutputState::Unknown` and `_` mapping to Unknown (67-68). map_media_state is pub(crate) (245), while the others are pub(super).
findings.recommendation: Make it a directory: src/obs/mapper/{mod.rs, event.rs, output.rs, scene.rs, media.rs, audio.rs, catalog.rs, session.rs}. map_version(v, endpoint, connection_id) takes the real values. Make everything pub(super). The only external users are obs/client.rs:22 and obs/event.rs:12, both inside obs, through `crate::obs::mapper`, so a mod.rs re-export keeps them compiling.
findings.risk: Low.
findings.verifier_note: All points verified. Only obs-internal code imports the mapper, so the directory move is safe.

findings.title: get_source_detail is a ~130-line method with up to 9 sequential round trips and string warnings
findings.evidence: The reads are settings (638-644), text defaults (653-660), filters (679-694), media for ffmpeg_source/vlc_source (695-709), mute (710-719), volume (720-730), and the four advanced-audio reads, already joined (731-759). English warnings are pushed at 671-673, 677, 693, 707, 716-718, 726-728 and 757 into SourceDetail.warnings: Vec<String> (domain/control.rs:73). No test scripts GetInputAudioBalance, GetInputAudioSyncOffset, GetInputAudioMonitorType or GetInputAudioTracks.
findings.recommendation: Move it to src/obs/inspect/source_detail.rs and split it into read_text_state, read_filters, read_media, read_audio_basic and read_audio_advanced. Only settings (with text defaults), filters, media and mute are independent, so join those. Volume and advanced audio are gated on the mute result, because that is where non-audio is detected, so they must stay sequential after mute. Add domain::control::is_media_kind. Use a typed SourceDetailWarning. Write wire tests before the split.
findings.risk: Inspector latency, and no test net.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. Line numbers corrected: the ffmpeg check is at 695, not 690, and the warnings are at the lines listed. The concurrency advice is narrowed, because volume and advanced audio depend on the mute or non-audio outcome (715, 720, 731).

findings.title: User-facing English strings in the adapter skip fl!, against the i18n rule
findings.evidence: English AppError::request messages appear at the lines listed. The only fl! in obs/ is scene_activation.rs 25-28. audio_presets.rs also localizes indirectly by calling AppError::user_message(), which runs fl! in infra/error.rs 54-72. So obs/ currently does presentation work in two different ways.
findings.recommendation: Return typed reasons (ControlRejection, InspectionLimit) inside ObsError and render them in ui/ or controller with new Fluent IDs in every locale. Remove the fl! from scene_activation.rs and the user_message calls from audio_presets.rs.
findings.risk: Untranslated errors reach users.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. Corrected the scene_activation range (25-28, not 17-20) and the sources.rs lines (37 and 44, not 281 and 288; the file is 314 lines). Added the indirect localization through user_message in audio_presets.rs.

findings.title: get_control_snapshot makes 7 independent reads in sequence and drops OBS rejections silently
findings.evidence: The seven requests are awaited one by one (525-568), and six of them use .ok() or if-let-Ok. The literal 4096 at 570 duplicates sources::MAX_INSPECTED_ITEMS (sources.rs:15). There is an unchecked i128 as i64 cast at 559. None of these requests is scripted in any test.
findings.recommendation: Move it to src/obs/workspace_snapshot.rs and join the six optional reads. Record OBS rejections as WorkspaceWarning::FacilityUnavailable. Use MAX_INSPECTED_ITEMS. Add wire tests.
findings.risk: Latency on every refresh, and no operator signal when a facility read fails.
findings.verifier_note: The sequential reads and swallowing are confirmed. Correction: a timeout is NOT indistinguishable here. The gate's deadline path retires admission (requests.rs 183-186), and the controller observes that through retirement. Only OBS-side rejections are swallowed, such as an unconfigured replay buffer. The latency claim is reasoned, not measured.

findings.title: RequestGate stores retirement twice and uses Mutex::expect; its timeout cannot be injected
findings.evidence: The fields `retired: watch::Sender<bool>` and `reason: Mutex<Option<RetirementReason>>` both hold retirement state. The lock sites at 102 and 112-113 use expect. REQUEST_TIMEOUT is a const (14). regression_tests.rs 483-502 waits up to 12 s of real time.
findings.recommendation: Collapse both into a single `watch::Sender<Option<RetirementReason>>` with send_if_modified, which keeps the rule that Deadline wins. That removes the Mutex and both expects. Inject the timeout, for example a #[cfg(test)] constructor or a parameter used by ObsClient::connect in tests, instead of relying on start_paused.
findings.risk: Slow CI test. Mainly simplification.
findings.verifier_note: Severity lowered from medium to low. Both critical sections (102-107, 111-114) contain only an Option assignment and a map, so no panic can poison the lock, and the poison cascade is theoretical. The ordering race is benign: the reason is written before retired=true, and readers use retirement_reason().is_some(), so they learn about retirement early, never late. Warning on the start_paused alternative: the test drives a real loopback socket, and ObsClient::connect wraps it in a 15 s tokio timeout (client.rs 74-75). Paused-clock auto-advance during socket I/O can fire timeouts spuriously, so prefer an injected timeout.

findings.title: run_if_valid nests selects and uses Result<Option<Result>> sentinels to encode admission outcomes
findings.evidence: Ok(None) means the gate closed or valid() returned false (166). Line 181 `response.unwrap_or(Err(obws::error::Error::Disconnected))` reports an invalidated skip as Disconnected. The caller in controller/workspace.rs 320-352 converts it with user_message() into a string, and it reaches evidence.finish (384), but WorkspaceLoaded is only sent while the ticket is still current (387-389).
findings.recommendation: Add `enum Admission<T> { Sent(obws::Result<T>), Skipped(SkipReason), Deadline }`, then split acquire and send. Map Skipped(Invalidated) to ObsError::Superseded. Keep regression_tests.rs 410-572 unchanged as the safety net.
findings.risk: A superseded command's evidence records a 'disconnected' error text.
findings.verifier_note: The mechanism is confirmed. The impact is overstated: the conflation is not a connection-level AppEvent, and the main caller discards superseded results by ticket check (workspace.rs 387-389). The remaining effect is the evidence or error text. Severity lowered to low.

findings.title: ObsClient mixes the transport handle, two admission gates, session metadata and an app-level revision counter, with temporal coupling
findings.evidence: The fields are at 53-60. connect hard-codes connection_id "default" (100), and the caller must call with_connection_id afterwards (session_controller.rs:308). next_observation (169-173) is called from controller/refresh_controller.rs 196, 212, 268, 493, 501, 511 and 516. The counter is an Arc shared by every clone of one connection, so it resets on each connect. The consumer-side trait pattern already exists: FakeOutputCommandClient at controller/output_controller.rs:390.
findings.recommendation: (1) Add ObsEndpoint { host, port, connection_id } and `connect(&ObsEndpoint, password)`, which removes with_connection_id and the placeholder. (2) The observation counter is per-connection. Either keep it, documented as a session-scoped revision, or move it into a controller-side `LiveSession { client, observation }` that is passed to the refresh tasks instead of a bare ObsClient. Do not just put it in session_controller as a field, because the refresh tasks only hold a client clone. (3) Use consumer-side port traits, following output_controller.rs:390.
findings.risk: Surface growth, and test seams that need sockets.
findings.verifier_note: Corrected the caller citation: there is no next_observation call at app_controller.rs:331, and the real calls are in refresh_controller.rs. Moving the counter has a hidden cost, because it is per-connection and tied to clones of ObsClient, so recommendation (2) was revised.

findings.title: The protocol fixture is scattered: the scripted mock lives in client.rs, and handshake/response JSON is written again in several places
findings.evidence: obs_fixture.rs provides only listen, accept and version. mock_client is at client.rs 1107-1145. Its importers are regression_tests.rs:4 and controller/workspace/audio_presets/tests.rs:2 (`obs::client::control_tests::mock_client`). client.rs 331-475 writes the handshake by hand. event.rs:69 builds an op:7 response by hand, and the controller test files (thumbnails.rs, workspace_lifecycle_tests.rs, session_controller.rs, final_regression_tests.rs, workspace.rs) contain hand-written "op":7 frames too. Requests confirmed as never scripted: StopReplayBuffer, the transition list and current reads, SetCurrentSceneTransition(Duration), TriggerStudioModeTransition, SetStudioModeEnabled, SplitRecordFile, CreateRecordChapter, SaveReplayBuffer, Start/StopVirtualCam, SetInputAudioMonitorType/SyncOffset/Balance/Tracks, the GetInputAudio* reads, StopStream, StartRecord/StopRecord, SetCurrentProfile and SetCurrentSceneCollection. Several of these names appear only as UI capability strings (ui/widgets/studio_controls.rs 215-217, transport_bar.rs). StartReplayBuffer, PauseRecord, ResumeRecord, StartStream and GetRecordStatus are scripted.
findings.recommendation: Grow obs_fixture.rs into a ScriptedObs builder, moving mock_client and unresponsive_client there. Update BOTH importers in the same commit, or keep a `pub(crate) use` shim in client::control_tests temporarily. Add response(), event() and request_data() helpers. Then add one wire test per untested request before any split.
findings.risk: The splits would otherwise move code with no regression net.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed by grep over every scripted requestType tuple. Additions: a second importer of mock_client in controller/, which the reviewer's plan missed; StartStream is actually scripted (StopStream is not). The baseline correction stands: wire tests cover far more than handshake plus GetVersion.

findings.title: Infallible collection is expressed with AppError plus expect
findings.evidence: `Ok::<_, AppError>` appears at 103 and 156, and `result.expect("operator property reads retain errors per input")` at 165. The clean form already exists at sources.rs 193-197 (Infallible plus unwrap_or_else(|never| match never {})). The same format! string is repeated at 107 and 110. The MediaStatus and SourceFilter mappings are duplicated at 123-127 and 144-148.
findings.recommendation: Use Infallible. Extract read_input_properties. Use the identity and mapper helpers.
findings.risk: Low.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. All line numbers corrected: the file is 104 lines, so the cited 297-372 and sources.rs 437-441 do not exist.

findings.title: Preset adapter returns Result<_, String> built from localized user_message()
findings.evidence: read_preset_input (13-31) and apply_preset_property (32-62) return Result<_, String> and call user_message() at 20, 44 and 61. InputObservation fields are Option<Result<_, String>> (domain/operator_input.rs 54-59).
findings.recommendation: Return Result<_, AppError>, later ObsError, and call user_message() in controller/workspace/audio_presets.rs.
findings.risk: Callers cannot branch on the error kind.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. Line numbers corrected: the file is 63 lines, so the cited 220-269 does not exist.

findings.title: Duration conversion is inconsistent: unchecked i128 as i64 casts in some places, try_from in others
findings.evidence: `whole_milliseconds() as i64` appears at client.rs 559, 703, 704 and 743 and at operator_inputs.rs 125-126. map_record_status uses u64::try_from(...).ok() (mapper.rs 134).
findings.recommendation: Add a checked helper mapper::time::millis and unit-test it with -1, 0 and i128 overflow.
findings.risk: Low.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. Line numbers corrected; the cited '1062 equivalent' is not a cast site. Truncation needs absurd values. The realistic divergence is negative values passing through in one path and being dropped in the other.

findings.title: get_stream_status and get_stream_health send the same GetStreamStatus request
findings.evidence: Both call streaming().status(). The health path is used by refresh_controller.rs:117, and the status path by controller/workspace.rs:532 and session_controller.rs:176.
findings.recommendation: Optional: map one response twice through a shared helper when moving both into src/obs/outputs.rs.
findings.risk: Low.
findings.verifier_note: The duplication is confirmed. The performance claim is refuted: no single code path calls both in one cycle (the refresh poll, the workspace read and shutdown are separate), so no round trip is wasted today. Recategorized from performance to code-smell.

findings.title: Magic numbers, and test-only convenience methods inside the production impl
findings.evidence: A 15 s timeout wraps obws's own connect_timeout (74-84). Other literals: screenshot 960x540 (606), thumbnail bounds 384x216 (1080-1081), 4096 (570). #[cfg(test)] methods on the production type: set_current_program_scene (204-210), execute_control (764-770) and get_all_audio_inputs (audio.rs 26-30). Visibility is a mix of pub and pub(crate).
findings.recommendation: Name the constants. Move the test conveniences into an ObsClientTestExt trait in obs_fixture.rs. Normalize visibility to pub(crate).
findings.risk: Low.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed. Corrected the thumbnail literal location (1080-1081, not 581-582).

findings.title: regression_tests.rs mixes several concerns and depends on a test module inside client.rs
findings.evidence: The groups are: operator reads (20-124), audio fail-closed (126-197, 597-656), inventory and graph (200-336, 623-636), gain wire format (339-378), admission and retirement (381-572), stats (575-594) and identity actions (658-706). Lines 4-5 have `use super::control_tests::mock_client; use super::*;`. The file is pulled in by #[path] at client.rs 1393-1395.
findings.recommendation: After obs-acl-15, put each group next to its module, then delete the file and the include.
